about: the site's plates, built by scripts/texture/build.py plates through the vendored fields.py. a size, path or rope width given as a name is read from tokens/details.json plate_inputs; a number is this spec's own. composite plates print one indexed image per mode; masks print a first and a spot plate per mode, inked by css. master maps each output file to the master plates it must equal, by pixels or by ink planes

opener.width_from: build_sketch.py build(): opener_plates(opener, W, H, mode, SKETCH_PATH, 58)

opener-phone.job: the overview's opener band at 600 px and below

band.job: an inner page head's slim band (lead decision 9); new, so its hash is recorded, not compared
band.h_from: up from the first 120, so the page title's knock in the lower left covers less of the rope
band.width_from: the sketch's rope width 58 scaled to the first 120 px band, 58 x 120 / 196, rounded; the band grew taller and the rope kept its weight

band-phone.job: an inner page head's slim band at 600 px and below; new, so its hash is recorded, not compared
band-phone.h_from: up from the first 120, for the same knock at 600 px and below

figure.job: the reading figure at the sheet's measure

empty.job: the empty and loading place: a light wedge of the first ink

empty-column.job: the empty place in a board column; new, so its hash is recorded, not compared
empty-column.w_from: the board column's empty field from 1280 px up. the world draws the wedge whole at the width it shows, so the column carries all three steps instead of a crop of the first
